entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi Charlie... I, um, I hope you can help. I need to return something and I'm just feeling so down about it.
I'm sorry to hear that. I can certainly look into a return for you. To get started, could I get your name and order number please?
Yes, it's Sarah Jenkins, order number VF-881-2950. It's for the new helmet I bought. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years, and I was so excited, but... it's just not right.
Okay, Sarah, I have your order pulled up here. I see the Pro-Frame helmet. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

It's just a preference, I guess. The color in the picture online looked so different. It doesn't match my gear at all. The box is still unopened, I haven't even touched it. I just feel awful because I really needed that money back for some bills.
I completely understand how disappointing it can be when a color isn't what you expected. Let me just check the policy for you. One moment.

Alright, Sarah, thank you for your patience. I see here that your helmet was delivered just six days ago. Our policy for standard items allows for returns up to 90 days from delivery, so you are well within the window. We can absolutely process this return for you.
Oh, really? That's... that's such a relief. Thank you so much, Charlie.

Of course. And I also see you're one of our VIP members. We really appreciate your loyalty. As a thank you, I've just emailed you a pre-paid return shipping label, so there will be no cost to send it back. We want to make sure you have gear you love and feel confident in. Your safety is our top priority, and that starts with having a helmet you'll actually wear.
Wow, free return shipping too? You've really turned my day around. Thank you. I was so worried.

It's my pleasure, Sarah. Just print that label, attach it to the original box, and you can drop it off at any post office. Once we receive it, you'll see a full refund to your original payment method within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's everything. You've been wonderful. Thank you again.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
